# Walpulse

> Walpulse creates and analyzes on-chain reputation signals for blockchain wallets.
> Signals are verifiable and explainable (A–F grades). The recipient interprets and decides.
> Walpulse does not perform KYC, Travel Rule, UIAF reporting, or compliance decisions.
